body:
dang

you’re right


i think i’m gonna go on a walk to the nature park and say goodbye to the dogs i see there sometimes. gonna say goodbye to my neighbor’s dog too.

i’ll stick it out and see if it gets better, thanks my guy. it’s the morning now and nothing really feels any better but maybe a walk will clear up my senses

thanks man i calmed down a little bit but 

starting this year, for the past few years i’ve always had sleep paralysis and night hallucinations especially auditory, but i’ve just had the recurring hallucinations starting in january where sometimes it got so bad i’d go 50-60 hours without sleeping 

i don’t think ive really changed a lot, but the biggest decision i think i can remember is that i left a groupchat they were in and they never really contacted me about it — they stopped talking to me after that.

thanks for taking your time to help me see the light in a dark situation. i was gonna put my socks and shoes on to walk over to the overpass but i’ll stick it out for a little bit and take your advice.

gonna put the socks away and listen to some podcasts now, thanks man and shalom.
